# The Python packages the Microkit SDK build uses (scripts/build-sdk.sh): the
# set `pip install sel4-deps` resolved to on 2026-10-07 for Python 3.12, each
# pinned by version and by the sha256 of its files on PyPI (the Linux arm64 and
# x86_64 wheels for Python 3.12, and the sdist). pip installs them with
# --require-hashes, so nothing else is accepted. Regenerate it, all of it, in
# its own commit when a pin moves.
